engine: studio-video-engine tests (copytree of the skill dir, live recipes)
symptom: Full-suite runs showed 6–23 failures that vanished on re-run (test_audio_recipes copytree hit a temp file recipes/qa/seda3zzjM deleted mid-copy; Q3 negative controls passed once; default-recipe tests broke when another builder flipped the default).
root_cause: Several builders edit the same live engine tree concurrently; tests copy the tree or read live recipes without a snapshot.
root_cause_status: inferred from mtimes + reproduced copy race (independent audit 2026-10-27)
fix_or_workaround: Assigned (audit gap #9): tests copy a recipe snapshot that ignores temp files; engine_tree_sha256 pinned into receipts. Root re-runs a full suite after builders stop before accepting.
prevention: One builder per package; never accept a builder's 'suite green' while others are editing; pin the engine tree in every receipt.
